Backup Power.note:
This is the final Wisconsin Department of Natural Resources air operation permit 154003740-P30, issued November 2016, at https://apps.dnr.wi.gov/warp_ext/AM_DownloadObject.aspx?id=626768. In the equipment list on the first pages, the line 'Stack S14, Turbine P32 - 50 MW Combustion Turbine (CT5) - Installed 1972, natural gas/#2 fuel oil' describes this unit as an ordinary generating turbine that runs on natural gas and fuel oil.

Backup Power:
- The permit never calls this turbine a backup or standby unit.
- The only units it calls emergency are separate diesel engines, P36 (black start engine) and P37 (emergency generator), both tied to Unit 3.
- So the value stays no. The permit implies it and does not use the words 'backup power', which is why this is medium confidence.

units.notes: Backup Power stays no, per the 2016 air permit. EIA-860M for September 2026 lists generator 5 at plant 4057 as retired in June 2020, matching GEM.
